user.title: Renovate Updates
user.description: Watch a repository for open Renovate pull requests and surface them as update entities.

data_description.repository: In owner/name form, for example octocat/infrastructure.
data_description.token: A fine-grained personal access token with Contents: read & write and Pull requests: read & write on this repository.
data_description.pr_author: The account that opens the pull requests. renovate[bot] is the hosted Mend Renovate app. Leave empty to match every open pull request, which is useful when nothing shows up.
data_description.merge_method: Must be enabled on the repository, or GitHub will refuse the merge.

reauth_confirm.title: Renovate Updates
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {repository} is no longer working. This is usually a fine-grained token missing 'Pull requests: Read and write'. Fix the token's permissions on GitHub and re-enter it, or paste a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the GitHub API.
error.invalid_repository: The repository could not be read. Check the name and that the token has access to it.
error.missing_pr_permission: The token cannot read pull requests. A fine-grained token needs 'Pull requests: Read and write' as well as 'Contents: Read and write' — Contents alone is not enough.

init.title: Renovate Updates options
init.description:
Watching {repository}.

To use webhooks, add this payload URL to the repository under Settings > Webhooks, with content type application/json, subscribed to the Pull requests, Pushes and Check suites events:

{webhook_url}

The payload is never read: a delivery only prompts a refresh, and the authenticated API call that follows is the source of truth.

data_description.fallback_interval_minutes: Used in webhook mode as a backstop for dropped deliveries. Set to 0 to rely on webhooks alone.
data_description.merge_method: Must be enabled on the repository, or GitHub will refuse the merge.
data_description.pr_author: The account that opens the pull requests, normally renovate[bot]. Leave empty to match every open pull request.
